translations.web: “ ‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.
translations.bsb: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I Myself will search for My flock and seek them out.
translations.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.
translations.asv: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.
